data.description: There is currently no indication of how many cards a player can hold in their hand. Place light outlines in the positions that cards will take when held in the hand. This should be an optional feature of the core engine hand rendering code.
data.title: Show an outline of card positions in the hand

data.author: Map
data.comment:
Intake questions:

**1. Visual style** — What should the card-position outlines look like? Proposed defaults:
- Stroke-only (no fill), 2px stroke width
- Color: semi-transparent grey (e.g.  at  alpha)
- Shape: card-sized rectangle matching the card dimensions ()

**2. When to show** — Should outlines appear:
- (A) Always, showing all positions including occupied ones (as ghost outlines behind existing cards)?
- (B) Only empty slots (positions beyond the current hand count up to )?
- (C) Only when the hand is NOT at capacity (showing remaining empty slots)?

**3. Configuration API** — How should this be controlled per HandView instance?
- (A) New  flag (per-instance)?
- (B) Global toggle in SettingsStore?
- (C) Both?

Please advise on these three items.

data.author: Map
data.comment:
Intake questions:

**1. Visual style** — What should the card-position outlines look like? Proposed defaults:
- Stroke-only (no fill), 2px stroke width
- Color: semi-transparent grey (e.g. 0x666666 at 0.5 alpha)
- Shape: card-sized rectangle matching the card dimensions (CARD_W x CARD_H)

**2. When to show** — Should outlines appear:
- (A) Always, showing all positions including occupied ones (as ghost outlines behind existing cards)?
- (B) Only empty slots (positions beyond the current hand count up to maxHandSize)?
- (C) Only when the hand is NOT at capacity (showing remaining empty slots)?

**3. Configuration API** — How should this be controlled per HandView instance?
- (A) New HandViewOptions.showPositionOutlines boolean flag (per-instance)?
- (B) Global toggle in SettingsStore?
- (C) Both?

Please advise on these three items.
